about_the_game:
This demo includes the first three in-game days of My Lovely Flower.

You’ll meet your first customers, start tending your greenhouse, and begin to uncover the unsettling quiet that surrounds your little flower shop.

Please note:
This demo represents a work-in-progress version of the game. Some features, visuals, and mechanics may differ from the final release. We’ve avoided story spoilers to preserve the full experience of the main game.
